messages:
Jamie Ortiz (AE): FYI we just got an RFI from Aureole Systems. Theyre asking for a capability matrix, a short blurb on quantization options + perf numbers for a 16k POC, and a security Q pack (KMS/HSM + data residency). Can eng + security help pull numbers?

Noah Patel (SSE): I can own the matrix. Quick clarifying Qs: POC targets? concurrency/throughput?

Jamie Ortiz (AE): POC asks: 150 concurrent streams, 30k embeddings/day, 99% EU data residency. They want 2-week POC pricing options (hosted vs small dedicated vs private w/ HSM).

Tom Hsu (Eng-ML): Draft matrix below — intended for the RFI table. Will need someone to sanity-check the latency rows.

Tom Hsu (Eng-ML): ```
Feature | Hosted | Dedicated (small pool) | Private (VPC/HSM)
------- | ------ | ---------------------- | ------------------
Context | up to 32k (model dep) | up to 32k | up to 32k
Typical gen p50 (16k) | 140-220 ms | 90-140 ms | 100-160 ms
Typical gen p95 (16k) | 600-900 ms | 350-500 ms | 380-550 ms
Embed p50 | 40-80 ms | 20-45 ms | 25-50 ms
Concurrency | bursty to 100s | reserved 100-500 | configurable
Quantization | bf16 / int8 options | int8 recommended | int8 + custom kernels
Key mgmt | Redwood KMS | customer KMS integ | customer HSM (add-on)
SLA | standard | SLA-backed | enterprise SLA
```

Lina Gomez (Security): For the security pack: we can state EU-only region pinning for Private and Dedicated, logs retention configurable, and HSM support as: "Customer-managed HSM or HSM-backed KMS is supported for Private deployments; plaintext keys never leave customer-controlled hardware. Documentation and audit artifacts available upon NDA." Legal signoff needed for SOC2/ISO docs.

Noah Patel (SSE): Costs: rough working numbers for a 2-week POC \u2014 hosted unoptimized estimate $24k (2 weeks @ their volume), with caching/quant -> ~$9k. Small dedicated 2-week reservation: ~$30k. Private POC with HSM add-on (2 weeks): starting estimate $55k plus integration. I'll double-check with finance.

Jamie Ortiz (AE): Good. Please flag anything that looks optimistic. Also include an ops note on fallback policy: if dedicated pool saturates we'll drain to hosted with throttling rules and customer notification.

Tom Hsu (Eng-ML): Ops blurb for RFI: "We provide automated routing policies — requests target reserved pools first. When capacity constraints occur, requests may be routed to compatible hosted or alternate pools per customer policy; operators can set cost/latency preferences. Quantized variants may be used to reduce unit cost while keeping latency targets."

Lina Gomez (Security): Adding HSM phrase approved. Also note: for Private we can offer HSM attestation reports and support customer-side key rotation.

doc-bot: Uploaded: aureole_rfi_attachments_v1.zip (drive link) :paperclip:

Noah Patel (SSE): I'll assemble the RFI bundle: matrix + short answers + pricing rows + security lines. Plan to post draft here by 4pm PT.

Jamie Ortiz (AE): Target to send to Aureole by EOD tomorrow. Thanks all :white_check_mark:
